attributes.name: below-hero strip content style
attributes.definition: How the horizontal strip near the hero is composed: its labels and separators.

values.value: italic serif text labels with glyph bullets
values.definition: Text labels in italic serif separated by decorative glyph bullets such as stars.
A row of brand or client logos.
Plain text labels or other content.

attributes.name: strip container treatment
attributes.definition: Whether the strip sits inside a distinct container such as a card, or runs open on the page background.

values.definition: Strip is enclosed in a rounded, filled card.
Strip has no enclosing card and sits directly on the page.

attributes.name: strip placement relative to hero
attributes.definition: Where the strip is positioned relative to the hero section.

values.definition: Strip sits beneath the hero section as a separate band.
Strip sits next to the hero CTA within the hero area.
Elsewhere on the page or not present.
